final: WITH c AS (SELECT o.recordvault AS order_ref, o.orderflow AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.recordvault, o.orderflow), s AS (SELECT order_ref, status, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS share FROM c), g AS (SELECT order_ref, status, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT order_ref, status, cnt, share, share - avg_share AS gap_above_avg FROM g ORDER BY gap_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10
